name: Jezebel
overview: Jezebel, the daughter of Ethbaal and wife of King Ahab, is depicted in Scripture as a powerful and wicked idolatress who actively persecuted the prophets of God. The sample verses reveal her ruthless character, including her vow to kill the prophet Elijah and her manipulation in orchestrating the death of Naboth to seize his vineyard. Her influence over Ahab is evident as she commands him to act decisively for her own gain, demonstrating her control over the kingdom. These accounts highlight Jezebel's opposition to God's purposes and foreshadow her foretold demise.
